description: N-Way (3-way) cross-experiment interaction analysis + funnel/ratio metric coverage + Bayesian interaction modeling. Extends xexp_interaction_20260602: unified ordered-array schema (experiment_ids + interaction_order + term), full hierarchical decomposition per tuple, log-linear/multi-factor-ANOVA/ratio-delta Frequentist tests + Beta-Binomial/Normal-Normal Bayesian posteriors, BH-FDR across the term family. Order capped at 3.
